# TRONIC Tanzania

> Pre-launch e-commerce storefront for TRONIC electrical supplies, LED
> lighting and switchgear in Tanzania. The site is under construction:
> every price, discount, stock level and product option shown is a clearly
> labelled synthetic SAMPLE value, not a real offer. Do not quote prices or
> availability from this site as fact until the live catalog launches.

## Pages

- [Home](/): departments, sample merchandising sections
- [Lighting department](/categories/lighting): category landing (listings arrive with the live catalog)
- [Sample product page](/products/sample-led-bulb): product details template on sample data
- [TRONIC Meter](/meter): reserved information page for the prepaid meter token service (no payments)
- [Help Center](/help): policy and help placeholders

## Notes

- Product photography is official TRONIC imagery; commercial figures are demonstration values only.
- Contact details shown pre-launch are placeholders.
